user.title: HA LiveKit
user.description: HA LiveKit is ready for automations and background Live Activities. Open the iOS app once after updating so Home Assistant can finish setup. Webhook path: {webhook_path}.

data_description.allow_legacy_webhook_secret: Disabled by default. Enable only while migrating an old webhook client that sends the shared secret directly; timestamped HMAC or the existing signed HMAC path should be used instead.
